reasoning.thinking_notes: Adaptive thinking is the ONLY thinking-on mode. Manual extended thinking (thinking:{type:'enabled',budget_tokens:N}) returns 400. Thinking is OFF unless you set thinking:{type:'adaptive'}. effort is the recommended control for thinking depth.
reasoning.effort_default: high (on all surfaces incl. Claude API and Claude Code)
reasoning.effort_caps_notes: max = absolute max capability, no token-spend constraints. xhigh = extended long-horizon (>30min, million-token budgets) — available only on Opus 4.8 and Opus 4.7. Recommended start: xhigh for coding/agentic, high for other intelligence-sensitive work. Effort levels recalibrated vs 4.7 (medium thinks somewhat more, high somewhat less, xhigh substantially more).

extra_features: mid-conversation system messages (role:'system' mid-array, no beta header)
models.recommended_use: Most capable GA model — complex reasoning, long-horizon agentic coding, high-autonomy work.

models.context_window: 1M tokens (new tokenizer, ~1x-1.35x token count vs prior models)

reasoning.effort_caps_notes: xhigh introduced here (Opus 4.7 + 4.8 only). max available. Respects effort more strictly than 4.6, esp. at low/medium.

since_jan_2026.summary: Yes — since Jan 2026 the Opus line advanced from 4.5 -> 4.6 -> 4.7 -> 4.8, and Sonnet 4.6 launched. Opus 4.8 (released 2026-05-28) is the current frontier and is NEWER than opus-4-8's predecessors opus-4-7/opus-4-6. There is NO opus-4-9, opus-5, sonnet-4-7, or haiku-4-6. The newest Sonnet is still sonnet-4-6 (2026-02-17) and the newest Haiku is still haiku-4-5 (2025-10-15, predates Jan 2026).
since_jan_2026.session_model_check: This session's model is claude-opus-4-8 — confirmed as the NEWEST GA Opus as of 2026-06-01. No newer GA Opus exists. (Claude Mythos Preview is a higher-intelligence gated research preview, not self-serve GA.)

notes: EFFORT LEVELS by tier (exact API strings, set via output_config.effort): Opus 4.8 = [low, medium, high, xhigh, max], default high. Opus 4.7 = [low, medium, high, xhigh, max], default high. Opus 4.6 = [low, medium, high, max], default high. Opus 4.5 = [low, medium, high, max], default high. Sonnet 4.6 = [low, medium, high, max], default high. xhigh is EXCLUSIVE to Opus 4.8 and Opus 4.7. The effort parameter is NOT supported on Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.1, or any pre-Opus-4.5 model.

effort is GA (no beta header). The complete API-accepted set is exactly {low, medium, high, xhigh, max}. Claude Code's 'ultracode' is NOT an extra API level — it pairs xhigh effort with standing multi-agent-launch permission.

Adaptive thinking models (thinking:{type:'adaptive'}): Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, Mythos. Opus 4.8 and Opus 4.7 are adaptive-ONLY (manual budget_tokens -> 400). Opus 4.6/Sonnet 4.6 still accept budget_tokens but deprecated. Opus 4.5 is manual-thinking + effort. Thinking is OFF by default on Opus 4.7/4.8 (must send thinking:{type:'adaptive'}).

1M context window: full 1M GA at standard pricing (no premium, no beta header) on Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, and Mythos. On Microsoft Foundry, Opus 4.8 is capped at 200k. The Sonnet 4.5 / Sonnet 4 1M beta (context-1m-2025-08-07) was RETIRED 2026-04-30 — those now cap at 200k.
Tokenizer: Opus 4.7 and later use a new tokenizer (~1x-1.35x, up to ~35% more tokens for the same text vs prior models). Re-budget max_tokens and cost.
Breaking on Opus 4.7+: temperature/top_p/top_k non-default values -> 400; assistant prefill -> 400; manual extended thinking -> 400.
Prompt caching: 5m write = 1.25x base input, 1h write = 2x base input, cache read = 0.1x base input. Min cacheable prompt on Opus 4.8 = 1,024 tokens (lower than 4.7).
Batch API = 50% discount on input+output (stacks with caching). Batches support up to 300k output tokens on Opus 4.8/4.7/4.6/Sonnet 4.6 via output-300k-2026-03-24.
Fast mode (research preview, Claude API only, not on Batch/Bedrock): Opus 4.8 = $10/$50 MTok; Opus 4.6/4.7 = $30/$150 MTok. Set speed:'fast'. Opus 4.6 fast mode deprecated 2026-05-28.
Data residency: inference_geo:'us' = 1.1x multiplier on all token categories (Opus 4.6 / Sonnet 4.6 and later only); 'global' (default) = standard. Earlier models 400 on the param.

Every model ID is a pinned snapshot. 4.6-generation-and-later dateless IDs (opus-4-6/4-7/4-8, sonnet-4-6) ARE the pinned snapshot, NOT evergreen pointers. Pre-4.6 dated IDs (sonnet-4-5-20250929, haiku-4-5-20251001) have convenience aliases (sonnet-4-5, haiku-4-5) that resolve to the latest dated snapshot.
Query capabilities programmatically via Models API (GET /v1/models, /v1/models/{id}) -> max_input_tokens, max_tokens, capabilities object.

Anthropic platforms: Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS, Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry. Console moved to platform.claude.com; docs.claude.com / docs.anthropic.com redirect to platform.claude.com/docs.

Catalog uses doc placeholder components <NextOpus/> / <NextOpusId/> which resolve to Claude Opus 4.8 / claude-opus-4-8 (cross-confirmed via the deprecations table, the whats-new-claude-4-8 page, the 2026-05-28 release note, and the anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-4-8 announcement).
